de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumTransactionFigureType

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumTransactionFigureType>
      • EnumTransactionFigureType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumTransactionFigureType>

    public enum EnumTransactionFigureType
extends Enum<EnumTransactionFigureType>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Type of transaction figures (A18).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
